sources.claim: ESET reports that FriedEx/BitPaymer was created by the authors of Dridex and documents shared implementation traits.
NHS Digital says FriedEx/BitPaymer is believed to have been created by the attackers responsible for Dridex.

curator_note: Modeled as shared creator/authorship, not derivation, because public sources support common authorship and code-trait overlap more clearly than BitPaymer being a direct Dridex descendant.
confidence_reason: ESET provides technical code-similarity evidence and an explicit authorship conclusion; NHS Digital independently reflects the same relationship in public alerting.
